entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes. It's VF886-01. The cycling shoes.
Got it. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Sonic Pro cycling shoes. Can you tell me what specifically is the issue with them?
They're just not right. I've tried everything. They're giving me blisters.
I'm sorry to hear that. Comfort is key. Did you have a chance to adjust the cleats to see if a different foot position might help?
Of course I did. I'm not an amateur. I just want a refund. The shoes don't work for me.

I understand completely. No problem at all. Let me just check the delivery date here... It looks like they were delivered 82 days ago. According to our policy, you're well within the 90-day return window.
Great. So you can process it?

Absolutely. I've just initiated the return process. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file right now. Once we receive the shoes, we'll process your full refund. Is there anything else I can help with?
Whatever. Just make sure the email actually shows up.
You should receive it within the next 5 minutes. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
